tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description: Use when you need demographic, property, EPC energy efficiency, broadband, or socio-economic context for a Great Britain unit postcode (England, Scotland, Wales). Returns full profile by default; use view="brief" (~80 tokens) for low-token, concise briefings when managing context budget. Do not use

tools.name: compare_postcodes
tools.description: Use when you need to directly contrast 2 to 5 Great Britain postcodes across affluence, safety, housing cost per m², broadband, and family suitability. Returns full profiles by default; use view="brief" (~80 tokens per postcode) to keep context compact alongside the comparison ranking. Do not use fo

tools.name: enrich_postcodes
tools.description: Bulk demographic, economic, and spatial lookup for 1 to 50 Great Britain postcodes. Returns brief profile by default (~80 tokens per postcode) to prevent context blow-up; use view="full" when all 113 metrics are needed. Cost-effective for 6 to 50 postcodes ($0.050 flat fee). For 1 postcode use looku

tools.name: summarise_outcode
tools.description: Use when you only have an outward code / district (e.g. SW1A, BB7, EH1, CF10) and need high-level district demographic and property statistics (~150 tokens). Do not use when an exact full unit postcode is available (use lookup_postcode).

tools.name: get_postcode_ai_brief
tools.description: Retrieve an ultra-lightweight, token-efficient natural language briefing, affluence tier, and persona profile (~80 tokens) for fast autonomous agent decision-making across Great Britain. Covers England, Scotland, and Wales (excludes Northern Ireland BT postcodes).

tools.name: get_property_and_energy_profile
tools.description: Retrieve real estate valuation (HM Land Registry / Registers of Scotland median house price, price per sqm, 3yr sales volume), EPC energy efficiency (current/potential band, retrofit upside), and Ofcom gigabit broadband connectivity for any Great Britain postcode. Covers England, Scotland, and Wales

tools.name: get_demographics_and_deprivation
tools.description: Retrieve Census demographic breakdown (ONS Census 2021 / NRS Scotland Census 2022 income estimate, qualifications, tenure, employment, age) and statutory IMD deprivation deciles (IoD 2025, WIMD 2025, SIMD 2020 crime safety, education, living environment) for any Great Britain postcode. Covers Englan

tools.name: screen_postcodes
tools.description: Rank and screen 2 to 10 Great Britain postcodes by a specific target metric (affluence, house price, crime safety, broadband speed, family suitability, or connectivity). Returns a sorted leaderboard. For 11 to 50 postcodes use enrich_postcodes; for full cross-metric comparison of 2 to 5 postcodes us

tools.description: $0.00 USDC reference tool (no payment or authentication required; subject to Terms of Service): Retrieve exact field specifications, mathematical calculation formulas, statistical scales, and data sources for any metric across Great Britain in the Postcode Context database.
